supporting_observations.claim: The alerted host ran ledgerlinkupd.exe from max.fischer's AppData\Local\LedgerLink directory, rather than the inventory-listed C:\Program Files\LedgerLink\ledgerlinkupd.exe path.

Proxy records show repeated HTTPS CONNECT attempts to update.ledgerlink.co at roughly five-minute intervals, with successful tunnels and later gateway errors; the observed hostname is update.ledgerlink.co, not the inventory-listed update.ledgerlink.com.
Host network records associate the repeated proxy connections with ledgerlinkupd.exe, including the connections at 13:43:56, 13:59:21, and 14:04:09 UTC.
The updater's repeated checks resemble the approved LedgerLink updater's stated approximately five-minute update-check behavior, but the executable location and hostname differ from the inventory.
The updater process ended at about 14:09:15 UTC, within the alert review interval.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records identify the CONNECT hostname and status, but the evidence does not show the HTTPS payload or what the updater sent or received.
The supplied records do not include the updater's hash, signature validation, file provenance, or a trusted-vendor confirmation of the observed path and hostname.
A successful proxy tunnel does not by itself establish that the remote content was benign or that any downloaded content executed.
claims_not_established: Whether update.ledgerlink.co is an authorized LedgerLink endpoint or a lookalike.
Whether the AppData copy of ledgerlinkupd.exe is authentic, authorized, or malicious.
Whether the updater downloaded or executed content, or whether any data was exfiltrated.
Whether the scheduled svc-ledger password rotation or job update is related to this workstation activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Obtain the updater executable's hash, signature and file provenance, and compare them with a trusted LedgerLink release or the organization's approved software inventory.
Confirm with the software owner or vendor whether update.ledgerlink.co and the AppData installation path are authorized.
Review endpoint file and process telemetry for updater downloads, child processes, file modifications, persistence changes, and execution after the proxy checks.
If available, obtain proxy TLS inspection or endpoint network telemetry that reveals the requests and responses associated with these checks.
unrelated_findings: Google Drive File Stream ran on the workstation; Google Drive is not among the listed approved cloud-storage services. Review separately; it does not determine this alert. (T255-00134, T255-00135)
Dropbox ran on the workstation; Dropbox is not among the listed approved cloud-storage services. Review separately; it does not determine this alert. (T255-00409, T255-00410)
Firefox connected to files.slack.com. The organization lists no other approved file-sharing services; review this activity separately. (T255-00124, T255-00130)
